### Do Not Receive Him
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/do-not-receive-him
Passage: 2 John 1:10-11
Points:
- Believers must hold firmly to essential truths such as the incarnation of Christ.
- Welcoming or providing a platform to false teachers gives dangerous sanction to heresy.
- The apostle is not forbidding outreach to unbelievers, but prohibiting official endorsement of deceptive leaders.
- Christians should evaluate their giving to ensure funds do not support work hostile to the gospel.

### Day 336: 2 John 7–13
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-336-2-john-713.html
Passage: 2 John 1:8
Points:
- Satan uses subtle doctrinal distortion rather than blatant lies to mislead believers.
- Denying that Jesus came in the flesh undercuts the true basis of salvation.
- Innate human spiritual hunger can easily be redirected into deceptive teaching.
- Churches and leaders carry a vital duty to guard their congregations from false voices.
- Authentic Christian living balances mutual love with diligent testing of doctrine.
